profile_text.body:
Cadence Design Systems is a public company headquartered in San Jose, California, and trades under the ticker CDNS. According to its own site, Cadence describes itself as a leading EDA and Intelligent System Design provider delivering hardware, software, and IP for electronic design. The company also describes itself as focused on being a great company, citing its culture, recognition on Fortune's 100 Great Places to Work, and investment in sustainability.

The site material does not name specific AI products, and no products are recorded for the company. Its stated position rests on electronic design automation and intelligent system design rather than on any named AI offering.

The company is registered with the SEC under CIK 0000813672. No lawsuits or MCP servers are recorded for it. California is listed as its law exposure jurisdiction, with a count of 281.
